Approved date must be on or before Posting date. Date granularity only.
Maximum minus minimum among PO, receipt and invoice totals must be <= KRW 1.00; use Decimal.
Vendor ID plus invoice number must be unique in this six-document population. Strip and uppercase IDs.
Created by and Approved by IDs must differ. This is an AP record check, not an ERP authorization audit.
